definition.help: Price = raw currency1 / raw currency0 = numerator1/denominator0. Both exact modes/directions, exact-output rounds input up. No partial AMM fallback or core LP/protocol fee on these custom trades; static poolFee must be0. All funders gift inventory to the fixed residual beneficiary; no individual funder refund rights. Tracked manager claims back inventory, independently bounded at int128.max.
